title: Twin knocked out when brother is sedated

tellings.quote: So he gave me a shot of something to knock me out and a minute later, Jack goes out cold.

plain: A man named Jim Weiner says that in the late 1950s, near Allentown, Pennsylvania, a doctor gave him a shot to knock him out, and a minute later his twin brother Jack went out cold too. He says a family doctor's report and a local newspaper article recorded it. He tells it as a sign of a strange bond between the twins, in a conversation about alien abduction.
